sources.shortCitation: GND authority record for Paul Mann, composer
sources.fullCitation: Deutsche Nationalbibliothek, GND 133442284, “Mann, Paul”, composer, born 1910 in Vienna and died 27 May 1983 in New York. The record carries the variant forms Wechselmann, Paul; Mawersky, Paul Stephan; Bachinger, Alois; Marois, Jean; and Walden, Peter, and links to BnF ark:/12148/cb14768347k, LCNAF nb2003055670, VIAF 3662538 and Wikidata Q31202678. The Library of Congress heading reads “Mann, Paul, 1910-1983” and cites the 1944 sheet “Tell me I'm the only one you care for”. The day of birth is contested: the German Wikipedia article gives 3 September 1910 while the GND gives 1910-10-03; both agree on the year, and on 27 May 1983 for the death. Accessed 1 August 2026.
sources.title: GND 133442284 — Mann, Paul

personNameVariants.publicNote: Birth name, recorded as a variant in GND. The same record lists four further working names — Mawersky, Paul Stephan; Bachinger, Alois; Marois, Jean; and Walden, Peter — but none of the linked sources associates those forms with a specific work.
